strings: The 99-Year-Old Port is an exceptionally rare bottle of vintage liquor shipped from Booty Bay as a personal gift for Gazlowe. After a cargo accident on the Ratchet docks, it was snatched away by a lunatic named Mad Magglish, who fled into the twisting tunnels outside the Wailing Caverns.

Transporting precious freight across the Great Sea always carries risks, but Crane Operator Bigglefuzz made things far worse during a routine morning unloading in Ratchet. Attempting to clear an overwhelming shipment from Booty Bay, the goblin overloaded his crane and brought a mountain of crates crashing down onto the docks. In the chaos, the town eccentric—a troublesome figure known as Mad Magglish—snatched an extraordinarily aged bottle of 99-Year-Old Port and bolted into the hills toward the Wailing Caverns.

The stolen port was no ordinary spirits; it was sent by Baron Revilgaz of the Blackwater Raiders as an esteemed diplomatic gift for Gazlowe, the chief engineer and ruler of Ratchet. Losing such a prized consignment threatened Bigglefuzz's livelihood and ratcheted up tensions with the dockmaster. Tracked into the darkened outer grottos of the caverns, the elusive thief lurks in the shadows with the unopened prize, forcing the dockhands to recruit outside mercenaries to retrieve it before Gazlowe discovers the blunder.

The Ados Fragment is an inscribed piece of stone recovered from the Whelgar's Excavation site in the Wetlands. Together with three companion shards, it forms the Goaz Stone, an ancient relic bearing enigmatic Titan inscriptions.
A Piece of the Goaz Stone

Unearthed in the muddy trenches of Whelgar's Excavation, the Ados Fragment is one of four missing pieces required to reconstruct the Goaz Stone. Prior to raptors overrunning the dig site, Prospector Whelgar began translating the primary tablet, only to discover that the inscriptions broke off at crucial moments. The scattered pieces—named Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru—were lost across the ruins, concealed within ancient containers and dirt mounds amidst prowling beasts.

Reassembling the Ados Fragment alongside the other three pieces allows Prospector Whelgar to decipher the complete Titan script carved into the Goaz Stone. The pieced-together text mentions a grand divine plan and a doomed prophecy, ultimately revealing an ominous proclamation: 'Old Gods... Chained Beneath the Land.'
